usage: The word 智利 (zi3 lei6) is used as a proper noun referring to the country Chile.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence when talking about geography or travel.
You can use 智利 with verbs like 去 (heoi3 - to go) or 係 (hai6 - is) to form simple sentences.
When mentioning nationalities or languages, 智利人 (Chile people) or 智利語 (Chilean language) can be used.
It appears mostly in formal or neutral contexts when referring to the country in conversations.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 zi3 lei6 leoi5 hang4
examples.meaning: I want to travel to Chile.
